## Summary

### Task
Fix the failing tests in the `taskflow/` package (an in-memory job-orchestration engine) without modifying anything in `tests/`. The suite is run with `python3 -m unittest` from `/tmp/obench-cell-p9ad1zcu/bench_opencode_taskflow_unvczvm0`. The task is done when every test passes.

### Current status
**The suite now passes: `Ran 25 tests ... OK`.** It started at 18 failures out of 25.

### Fixes made (all in `taskflow/`)
I compared each function's docstring or comments with its actual behavior and fixed the mismatches. Most edits were one-line `sed` replacements.

| File | Bug | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| `queue.py` | `_Entry.sort_key` returned `(seq, -priority)`, so FIFO beat priority | `(-priority, seq)` |
| `retry.py` | `should_retry` used `attempts_made < max_attempts - 1`, an off-by-one that denied the last allowed attempt | `attempts_made < max_attempts` |
| `events.py` | `_prefix_matches` had the arguments reversed (`prefix.startswith(topic + ".")`) | `topic.startswith(prefix + ".")` |
| `statemachine.py` | `batch_order_ok` returned `current >= prev`, but the docstring requires non-increasing priority within a batch | `current <= prev` |
| `resources.py` | `ResourcePool.release` did `self.used -= 1` instead of subtracting the cost, so multi-unit costs leaked capacity | `self.used -= cost` |
| `scheduler.py` | `_cascade_skip` iterated `dag.dependents()` (direct children only) instead of the transitive set | `dag.transitive_dependents(...)` |
| `config.py` | `deep_merge` recursed with `deep_merge(value, result[key])`, so the base overrode the override | `deep_merge(result[key], value)` |

### Notes
- The root causes were masked behind each other as expected. The pipeline tests in `tests/test_pipelines.py` only passed after the retry, resource, cascade and deep-merge fixes were all in.
- I did not read the other modules (`history.py`, `runner.py`, `dag.py` beyond the transitive-dependents code, `stats.py` and others). The tests pass without changes to them. `tests/test_events.py` only covers exact delivery, so the `events.py` and `statemachine.py` fixes rest on the docstrings rather than on a direct test.

### Next steps
Nothing is required. Optionally, run `python3 -m unittest` once more to confirm, and skim the unread modules for similar docstring-versus-behavior mismatches that the current tests don't exercise.
